prompts.hero: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied photograph IMG_20261029_101756.jpg of a physical handmade block figure. Create a clean 16:9 landscape product photograph (prefer 2048 x 1152). Reframe/reposition the EXACT existing figure and its natural contact shadow so the full figure silhouette bounding box is horizontally centered at 50% and vertically centered at 50%, with approximately 12% empty margin above its head and below its feet. Extend the existing warm grey seamless photographic background naturally. Preserve the figure faithfully: identical pose, camera angle, asymmetry, silhouette, handmade folded paper edges, black block hair, rectangular dark glasses, smiling pixel face, green left half and brown right half of clothing, grey foot bases, texture and original lighting. Do not redesign, repaint, straighten, symmetrize, or beautify the figure. No new objects, no text, no collage, no frames. Full body completely visible, enough empty left/right background. The only intended change is centering/reframing and clean seamless background extension.
